headline: Finance Subcommittee reviewed wage history, budget stressors, and parking fee plans; no formal votes taken on policy changes.
summary: The Finance Subcommittee discussed budget stressors including fixed costs, health insurance, pension costs, debt service, and energy costs. The committee also discussed parking fees tied to a price index and the need for an escalator clause. No formal votes were taken on these items; the meeting adjourned after discussion.
decisions: Motion to adjourn the meeting was approved.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to Adjourn by C. Juran, seconded by C. McDonough. So voted.
